note: Curated short activities. No health, diagnostic or scoring content. Locale-aware: *_en fields are used when the senior's locale is en.

activities.title: 一年有几个月
activities.prompt_en: How many months are in a year?

activities.title: 一天有几个小时
activities.prompt_en: How many hours are in a day?

activities.title: 春天的颜色
activities.prompt: 春天里，树叶一般是什么颜色？
activities.prompt_en: In spring, what colour are leaves usually?

activities.title: 一周有几天
activities.prompt_en: How many days are in a week?

activities.title: 冬天穿什么
activities.prompt: 天气很冷的时候，出门最好带上什么？
activities.prompt_en: When it is cold, what is good to take outside?

activities.title: 茶的故乡
activities.prompt: 泡茶一般用什么样的水？
activities.prompt_en: What water is usually used to make tea?

activities.title: 小时候的家
activities.title_en: The home you grew up in
activities.prompt: 说说你小时候住的地方吧，门口是什么样子的？
activities.prompt_en: Tell me about the place you grew up in. What was the doorway like?

activities.title: 第一次远行
activities.prompt: 你还记得第一次出远门是去哪里吗？
activities.prompt_en: Do you remember the first long trip you took?

activities.title: 拿手菜
activities.prompt: 你做过最拿手的一道菜是什么？
activities.prompt_en: What is a dish you were really good at cooking?

activities.title: 老朋友的趣事
activities.title_en: A funny story about an old friend
activities.prompt: 想起哪位老朋友，让你觉得开心？
activities.prompt_en: Which old friend makes you smile when you think of them?

activities.title: 年轻时的爱好
activities.title_en: A hobby from your younger days
activities.prompt: 年轻的时候，你最喜欢做什么？
activities.prompt_en: What did you enjoy most when you were younger?

activities.title: 院子里的一棵树
activities.prompt: 你住过的地方，有没有一棵特别的树或者花？
activities.prompt_en: Was there a special tree or flower where you lived?

activities.title: 记住三样东西
activities.prompt: 记住这三样：苹果、雨伞、火车。等一下我问问你。
activities.prompt_en: Remember these three: an apple, an umbrella, a train. I will ask later.

activities.title: 买东西清单
activities.prompt: 想一个要买的三样东西，说给我听，我记着。
activities.prompt_en: Think of three things to buy and tell me; I will keep them.

activities.title: 今天的顺序
activities.prompt: 说说今天早上到现在做过的三件事，按顺序讲。
activities.prompt_en: Tell me three things you did this morning, in order.

activities.title: 厨房里的东西
activities.prompt: 说说厨房里摆着的三件东西，看看能说几样。
activities.prompt_en: Name three things in your kitchen and see how many you remember.

activities.title: 颜色接力
activities.prompt: 我们说三种颜色，红、蓝、黄，然后你再说一遍。
activities.prompt_en: We say three colours: red, blue, yellow. Then you repeat them.

activities.title: 家里的人
activities.prompt: 说说家里有哪几个人，一个个来。
activities.prompt_en: Tell me who lives in your home, one by one.
